title: Ferrari: Federated Feature Unlearning via Optimizing Feature Sensitivity
reasoning: The paper focuses on Federated Unlearning (FU) to address privacy (the 'right to be forgotten') and algorithmic bias in classification tasks. It utilizes standard datasets for image, tabular, and text classification (e.g., MNIST, CIFAR, BERT for IMDB) and focuses on privacy and fairness metrics rather than evaluating religion, spiritual beliefs, or moral reasoning.
